charmancer-step3-traits: Assign a number of d6 dice to your character traits. A trait rolls 1, 2, or 3 dice, and each number must be used once.
charmancer-step-attributes: Assign your character's attributes. Your age determines how many points you have to spend, and your body weight limits how Strong or Agile you can be. Legendary CAN NOT be used during character creation, but can be attained during adventures.
trait-disease-resistance-desc: Your body's ability to resist the effects of bacterial or viral intrusions. Once infected, a disease may take more than one resistance roll to recover from.
trait-memory-desc: Recalling information that your character has been exposed to. Negotiate with the GM why your character would know something from their experience. Each time the GM says you remember something, take note of it.
trait-toxin-resistance-desc: Your body's ability to resist the effects of a natural (e.g. occurring biologically) or synthetically-based chemical, whether based on dosage or other mechanisms. Accumulation of the chemical can increase the difficulty to resist the effects of the toxin.
charmancer-step-skills: Assign your character's skills, and Survival. Your age determines how many points you have to spend.
skill-legerdemain-desc: Sleight of hand, escaping from bonds, forgery, disguises.
skill-linguistics-desc: Practice in the fundamentals of languages. This skill does not mean that you are fluent in all languages, but with sufficient exposure you have the ability to communicate and understand non-native languages.
skill-logic-desc: Governs deductive and inductive reasoning. Can be used both in (philosophical) debate or in piecing together a puzzle.
skill-mechanics-desc: Understanding how objects work. Used to both repair and break objects.
skill-survival-desc: Finding tracks, developing naturally derived medicines, flora and fauna identification, foraging for food and water. Survival does not translate to immediate success in alien ecologies, but may reduce the amount of time necessary to understand the nature of those ecologies.
skills-defensive-desc: Used in combat, and in response to being attacked, defensive skills eliminate damage from occurring. All defensive skills require 1 Reaction to use.
skills-defensive-cost-note: Requires 1 Stamina and 1 Reaction, unless noted otherwise.
skill-defensive-parry-desc: Requires 1 Stamina. Parry an attack with your weapon. If you were targeted with a melee attack and successfully parried, you may riposte as part of the same reaction: a counter-attack that costs no reaction (but still costs Stamina) and lets you move up to your height. This riposte may itself be parried, with the original attacker now considered the defender. Objects larger or smaller than your weapon may be harder or easier to parry.
skill-defensive-deflect-desc: Requires 1 Stamina. Use your armor or shield to deflect an attack. This does not prevent you from coming into contact with the attack, so if there are additional effects (e.g. a heavy attack avoided but you're still knocked down), you may still be subject to them.
skill-defensive-dodge-desc: Requires 2 Stamina. Dodge out of the way of an attack. You must be able to move and have space to move into. On a success, you may move up to your standing long jump distance away from your original position.
skills-fighting-desc: Used to inflict damage on a target.
skill-fighting-unarmed-melee-desc: Requires 1 Stamina. Often referred to as Martial Arts, this fighting style relies on the character's body to do damage. The material of the target should be considered when determining the damage of an unarmed attack.
skill-fighting-armed-melee-desc: Requires 1 Stamina. Utilizes a held object to inflict damage. The material of the target and the type of object/weapon should be considered when determining the damage.
skill-fighting-ranged-shot-desc: Requires 1 Stamina. Utilizes an object to fire a projectile to inflict damage.
skill-fighting-ranged-thrown-desc: Requires 1 Stamina. Object or creature can be thrown to inflict damage. Objects not designed for the purposes may have a lessened impact. Weight of the creature or object should be considered when determining damage.
